# StripeStick

> StripeStick is a patent-pending golf alignment stick that clips to your shirt with magnets and turns with your shoulders and hips, so a golfer can see and feel their swing plane during the swing. It is launching soon. A waitlist is open at https://stripestick.com/waitlist. Slogan: "See it. Feel it. Stripe it."

## What it is

- Category: hands-free golf training aid, worn on the body.
- How it works: a slim backing rail sits under the shirt, and the stick attaches to it through ordinary fabric with magnets.
- Why it differs: ground alignment sticks show aim, not movement. Video shows a fault after the swing. Mirrors only work where there is a mirror. Lessons do not come home with you. StripeStick gives feedback during the swing.
- Status: patent pending, not yet on sale. Price has not been announced.

## What is in the box

- StripeStick: 36 in (91.4 cm) carbon-fiber stick with a round profile and three magnet positions (A, B, C).
- Backing rail: slim, skin-safe rail, 4.5 in (11.4 cm) long, 0.4 in (10 mm) wide and about 0.1 in (2–3 mm) thick.
- Stores in any golf bag.

## Swing faults it addresses

- High hands at the top. Set the stick across the trail shoulder front to back, emulating Ben Hogan's "pane of glass" concept. When the hands extend above the shoulder plane in the backswing, you feel the stick.
- Not enough hip turn. Set the stick across the waist. It shows how far the hips rotate on the way back, so a stalled turn is easy to spot.
- Hips spinning out. Keep the stick at the waist and make sure the hands drop in front of the stick before completing the turn.

## FAQ

- Will it work with my shirt? It is designed for common golf shirts, from thin performance polos to heavier layers.
- Is it safe? The magnets are tuned to let go under excess force. Keep the magnets away from pacemakers and other implanted medical devices, and away from cards and phones.
- Can I use it on the course? It is made for the range and practice swings. Using a training aid during a scored round breaks the Rules of Golf.
- Where does the rail go? At the top of your shoulder, or at your belt line. A magnetized strip sits beneath your clothing and attaches to StripeStick to holds it in place.
